why: A wasm module's budget is held both ways by `cargo xtask check-wasm`: over it fails, and so does more than 5% under it. Each budget is 2% over the module measured on CI's Linux runner, to the next ten kilobytes, and moves only through `cargo xtask sizes --from DIR --why SENTENCE`, which adds a row here saying what moved it; the figures before this record began are in the history of `bindings/wasm/size.json`.
